findings.F1: The effect is on the predicted side but short of the bar. Over 5 days the top third of forecasts beats the bottom third by 0.77 % (Welch t 1.64, 1139 cases each, 3419 grid cases). The same grading is clearer on shorter horizons: over 1 day the gap is 0.36 % (t 3.93, 17380 cases) and over 2 days it is 0.52 % (t 2.88, 8650 cases). Over 10 and 20 days the gap is larger, 1.28 % and 1.83 %, but less certain (t 1.38 and 1.00, 1691 and 827 cases).
findings.F2: The effect varies across coins and is partly carried by ZEC. Over 5 days the gap is 3.24 % (t 2.43) on ZEC, 1.21 % on ETH, 0.70 % on BTC and 0.60 % on XRP. It is negative on LTC (-0.83 %) and XMR (-0.12 %). Without ZEC the pooled gap falls to 0.67 % (t 1.38, 2729 cases).
findings.F3: The effect varies over time. The gap is negative in 2018 to 2020 (-1.28 %, -0.89 %, -0.12 %) and positive in every year from 2021 to 2025 (+0.96 % to +2.22 %, t up to 1.97 in 2024). No single year clears t 2, so the effect is present in later periods but the data per year is thin.
findings.F4: The two sides of the idea differ.
findings.F5: The size of the move is large enough against cost only in the strongest cases.
findings.F6: The grading holds on both sides separately at 5 days. Within up days, the slope of the 5-day excess return on the size of the move is +0.0022 per forecast point (t 2.51, 1557 cases). Within down days it is +0.0020 (t 2.55, 1718 cases). The test's one-sided thirds split diluted this, because the bottom third was mostly near-still days whose returns are noisy.

ideas.same-idea-on: instruments: BTC, ETH, LTC, XMR, XRP, ZEC, ADA, DOGE, LINK, TRX, UNI, AAVE, AVAX, SOL, INJ, NEAR, SUI, TAO, ONDO; bar: 1d; period: folds A, B, C, D
ideas.name: large day, more coins
ideas.idea: The larger a coin's absolute return over its last day, the higher its return over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: Treat a day of unusually large movement, up or down, as a reason to lean long the coin for the following 5 days.

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's rise over its last day, the higher its return over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: Treat an unusually large up day as a reason to lean long the coin for the following 5 days, more the larger the day.
ideas.name: large up day continues
